# SEO-628: Keep preview URLs unguessable and excluded from indexing

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

## Statement

A URL that exposes unpublished content contains a high-entropy token, expires, and carries a directive suppressing indexing, so possession of the link is the only way to reach it and holding it does not make the content public.

## Rationale

Preview links are shared by email and chat where they leak into referrer headers and link previews, so a guessable or permanent preview URL publishes the draft it was meant to circulate privately.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ],
  "any": [
    "cms",
    "authentication",
    "content_publication"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Generate the token from a cryptographic source, record an expiry the server enforces, and emit the suppression directive on every preview response. Do not derive the token from the content identifier or a timestamp.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Request a preview URL after its expiry and request a sequential variant of its token, recording the status and the indexing directive returned in each case.
- Evidence: `HTTP_STATUS`, `RENDERED_HTML`, `HTTP_HEADER`
- Automated check: none.
